Observing_System.description: HAYABUSA with LIGHT DETECTION AND RANGING INSTRUMENT

Table_Character.description: Hayabusa LIDAR Calibrated Data Record, filtered version

Field_Character.name: MET
Field_Character.description: Mission elasped time (MET) in spacecraft ticks each equal to 1/32s when the laser shot was fired.

Field_Character.name: UTC
Field_Character.description: Time when the laser shot was fired, converted to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) using the project- supplied clock kernel to convert MET into Terrestrial Dynamical Time (TDT) seconds past the J2000 epoch, and by accounting for leap seconds and the offset between atomic time and UTC, to a standard calendar representation of UTC.

Field_Character.name: RANGE
Field_Character.description: Distance or Range in KM measured by the HAYABUSA LIDAR along the boresight to the surface.

Field_Character.name: SPCX
Field_Character.description: X-coordinate of spacecraft in asteroid body-fixed coordinates.

Field_Character.name: SPCY
Field_Character.description: Y-coordinate of spacecraft in asteroid body-fixed coordinates.

Field_Character.name: SPCZ
Field_Character.description: Z-coordinate of spacecraft in asteroid body-fixed coordinates.

Field_Character.name: BLX
Field_Character.description: X-coordinate of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates using the spacecraft position, the measured range and the LIDAR boresight vector.

Field_Character.name: BLY
Field_Character.description: Y-coordinate of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates using the spacecraft position, the measured range and the LIDAR boresight vector.

Field_Character.name: BLZ
Field_Character.description: Z-coordinate of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates using the spacecraft position, the measured range and the LIDAR boresight vector.

Field_Character.name: BEX
Field_Character.description: X-coordinate of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates from intersect of the LIDAR/NIRS boresight with shape model of Itokawa using the spacecraft position (SPCX,SPCY,SPCX).

Field_Character.name: BEY
Field_Character.description: Y-coordinate of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates from intersect of the LIDAR/NIRS boresight with shape model of Itokawa using the spacecraft position (SPCX,SPCY,SPCX).

Field_Character.name: BEZ
Field_Character.description: Z-coordinate of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates from intersect of the LIDAR/NIRS boresight with shape model of Itokawa using the spacecraft position (SPCX,SPCY,SPCX).

Field_Character.name: INCIDENCE
Field_Character.description: Solar incidence angle at the center of the field of view of LIDAR/NIRS.

Field_Character.name: EMISSION
Field_Character.description: Emission angle from the center of the field of view of LIDAR/NIRS.

Field_Character.name: PHASE
Field_Character.description: Solar phase angle at the center of the field of view of LIDAR/NIRS.

Field_Character.name: FOVL
Field_Character.description: Mean size of the LIDAR field of view.

Field_Character.name: FOVN
Field_Character.description: Mean size of the NIRS field of view.

Field_Character.name: LONGITUDE
Field_Character.description: Longitude of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates using the spacecraft position, the measured range and the LIDAR boresight vector.

Field_Character.name: LATITUDE
Field_Character.description: Latitude of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates using the spacecraft position, the measured range and the LIDAR boresight vector.

Field_Character.name: INT_LONGITUDE
Field_Character.description: Longitude of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates from intersect of the LIDAR/NIRS boresight with shape model of Itokawa using the spacecraft position (SPCX,SPCY,SPCX).

Field_Character.name: INT_LATITIUDE
Field_Character.description: Latitude of center of LIDAR/NIRS footprint in asteroid body fixed coordinates from intersect of the LIDAR/NIRS boresight with shape model of Itokawa using the spacecraft position (SPCX,SPCY,SPCX).

Field_Character.name: MEAN_INCIDENCE
Field_Character.description: Mean incidence angle from N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS.

Field_Character.name: MEAN_EMISSION
Field_Character.description: Mean emission angle from N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS.

Field_Character.name: MEAN_PHASE
Field_Character.description: Mean phase angle from N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS.

Field_Character.name: MEAN_LONGITUDE
Field_Character.description: Mean longitude of N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS that intersect the asteroid shape model using the estimated spacecraft location (SPX,SPY,SPZ).

Field_Character.name: MEAN_LATITUDE
Field_Character.description: Mean latitude of N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS that intersect the asteroid shape model using the estimated spacecraft location (SPX,SPY,SPZ).

Field_Character.name: MININMUM_LONGITUDE
Field_Character.description: Minimum longitude of N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS that intersect the asteroid shape model using the estimated spacecraft location (SPX,SPY,SPZ).

Field_Character.name: MINIMUM_LATITUDE
Field_Character.description: Minimum latitude of N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS that intersect the asteroid shape model using the estimated spacecraft location (SPX,SPY,SPZ).

Field_Character.name: MAXIMUM_LONGITUDE
Field_Character.description: Maximum longitude of N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS that intersect the asteroid shape model using the estimated spacecraft location (SPX,SPY,SPZ).

Field_Character.name: MAXIMUM_LATITUDE
Field_Character.description: Maximum latitude of N of 9 points in a 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS that intersect the asteroid shape model using the estimated spacecraft location (SPX,SPY,SPZ).

Field_Character.name: N
Field_Character.description: Number of points on the 3 by 3 grid delineating the square field of view of NIRS that intersect the asteroid shape model using the estimated spacecraft location (SPX,SPY,SPZ). A value of 5 means ~5/9 of the NIRS field grid intersected Itokawa. This grid was used to compute the mean, minimum, and maximum longitude and latitudes above.
